stops.note: to deviate from a straight furrow, to be crazy, from de- (from) and lira (furrow)
stops.meaning: to deviate from a straight furrow, to rave

stops.note: formed as a noun for a state of wild, confused excitement
stops.meaning: a state of wild, confused excitement

stops.note: adopted directly for a disturbed state of mind involving confusion
stops.meaning: a disturbed state of mind involving confusion and restlessness

current_meaning: an acutely disturbed state of mind marked by confusion and restlessness
